transcript: Discovery call with Acme Corp. Client mentioned they are evaluating other vendors. Price was brought up as a concern. They said budget approval is still pending. Overall tone was cautiously interested.

Follow-up call. Client said they're still waiting on budget. Mentioned a competitor demo is scheduled for next week. They asked about our pricing tiers again. Said they need to justify the spend internally.
Technical deep dive. Client's engineering team was engaged and positive. But the procurement lead joined late and reiterated budget concerns. They asked if we offer flexible payment terms.
Check-in call. Client said they are 'evaluating options' and need to justify spend internally. Tone was more hesitant than before. They mentioned a competing vendor offered a discount.
Client asked about contract flexibility and whether we could do a pilot before full commitment. They said leadership is questioning the ROI. They also asked about our cancellation policy.
Brief call. Client said they're 'reconsidering priorities' for Q4. Asked if we could delay the start date. Mentioned budget may be reallocated to another initiative.
